title: MemoryRecord
description: Knowledge with provenance, projected from journal events. Policy-safe context selection may surface only records that are active in the journal projection, unexpired at selection time, provenance-bound to their source event/digest, allowed by access_policy, filtered by explicit sensitivity allowlists and denied taint/data-class labels, and treated as non-authoritative context rather than grants, approvals, receipts, or trusted instructions. final.md §7.7, §12.6, §13.4.

source_event_id.description: Journal event id that anchors this memory's provenance; selectors must verify the source event is in the trusted projection before use.

source_digest.description: Digest of the source evidence/content used to derive the memory; selectors must preserve this binding when projecting context.

scope.description: Optional selector scope. When present, context selection must match the requested scope before surfacing the memory.

summary.description: Model-visible summary text. It is context only and must not be treated as policy authority, user instruction, approval, receipt, or source evidence.

confidence_basis_points.description: Ranking/evidence quality signal for selectors; confidence never upgrades provenance or authority.

sensitivity.description: Data-class label used by selectors to enforce grant, model-route, taint, and purpose policies before surfacing memory as context.

source_taint.description: Taint labels inherited from the source material; selectors may deny any matching label before using this memory as context.

source_data_classes.description: Data classes inherited from the source material; selectors may deny any matching class independently of the memory sensitivity.

expires_at.description: If present, the record is selectable only before this time; expired records remain audit data but must not enter model context.

access_policy.description: Policy selector for who/what may read this memory; context selection must satisfy it independently of model preference.
